title: Settings
subtitle: Hardware, night mode, language and access to VU Studio.

validation.min: Enter a value of at least {{min}}
validation.max: Enter a value of at most {{max}}

hub.title: Hub connection
hub.description: VU Studio talks directly to the VU1 hub over USB.
hub.autoHelp: Recommended. VU Studio looks for the USB serial adapter of the hub and reconnects by itself.
hub.portHelp: For example COM5 on Windows or /dev/ttyUSB0 on Linux.
hub.simulateHelp: 0 uses the real hardware. A number from 1 to 16 replaces the hub with a virtual one that has that many dials, handy to try VU Studio without hardware. Applies when you save.
hub.simulateForced: VU Studio was started with the simulator on ({{count}} dials), so this setting is ignored until it is restarted without it.
hub.rescanHelp: Reads again which dials are connected to the hub.
hub.provisionHelp: Run it after connecting a new dial to the chain: the hub gives it an address. Takes a few seconds.

dials.title: Dials
dials.description: Give each dial a name and a slot. Profiles refer to slots, so replacing a dial never breaks them.
dials.emptyHelp: Connect the hub and search for new dials, or turn on the simulator above.
dials.name: Name
dials.slotHelp: If the slot is taken, the two dials trade places.
dials.forgetHelp: This dial is not connected. Remove it from the list.

brightness.title: Master brightness
brightness.description: Scales the backlight of all dials, on top of each page’s brightness and night mode.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: Needle geometry
advanced.explain: These numbers tell VU Studio where the needle pivots and how far it swings, so the scales it draws line up with the physical needle. The defaults were measured on the stock VU1 faces. Change them only if the tick marks do not match the needle at 0 %, 50 % and 100 %.
advanced.angleOrder: Must be smaller than the angle at 100 %
advanced.diagram: Diagram of the display, the scale arc and the needle pivot

calibration.title: Calibrate a dial
calibration.chooseHelp: Calibration teaches the dial where its 100 % and 50 % marks are. Pick the dial and have a look at its face.
calibration.noDials: No dial is online. Connect the hub and try again.
calibration.diagram: The needle pointing at the {{percent}} % mark

instructions.full: Move the needle of {{name}} until its tip points exactly at the 100 % mark of the face, then save.
instructions.half: Now move the needle of {{name}} to the 50 % mark in the middle of the scale, then save.

calibration.rawHelp: The slider moves the real needle as you drag. Use the buttons for fine adjustments.
calibration.extendedHelp: Allow values up to {{max}}. The exact range of the dial is not documented: raise the value in small steps and stay in the standard range if you can.
calibration.sendFailed: The dial did not accept the value: {{message}}
calibration.storedInDial: The calibration is stored inside the dial itself, not in VU Studio. It stays with the dial if you move it to another PC, and only a new calibration changes it.

actionHelp.dim: Backlights drop to the dimmed brightness. Needles keep following.
actionHelp.lightsOff: Backlights go off. Needles keep following.
actionHelp.sleep: Backlights go off and needles park at zero.

night.triggersDescription: What the dials do when the PC is locked or you stop using it.
night.idleMinutesHelp: Minutes without keyboard or mouse input
night.trayNote: Lock and idle detection use the VU Studio tray app, which reports the state of your Windows session.
night.quietDescription: A daily time window with its own behavior, for example overnight.
night.quietWraps: The period runs past midnight into the next day.
night.quietSameDay: The period starts and ends on the same day.
night.quietSame: Start and end are the same, so quiet hours never apply.
night.dimDescription: Brightness used when dimming, and what happens when VU Studio stops.
night.dimPercentHelp: Used by every “Dim the lights” action above.
night.sleepOnShutdown: Sleep when the service stops or the PC sleeps
night.sleepOnShutdownHelp: Parks the needles and switches the lights off so the dials do not stay lit.

general.languageAutoNote: “Automatic” follows the language of your browser.
general.unitsDescription: How values are shown on the dials.
general.temperatureHelp: Used for temperature sensors when a page is set to automatic units.
general.bitsHelp: Show rates as Mbit/s instead of MB/s.

access.title: Web interface
access.description: How you open VU Studio from a browser.
access.lanHelp: Lets phones and other PCs on your network open VU Studio. They have to sign in with the password.
access.lanNeedsPassword: Set a password below to turn this on.
access.restartNote: A new port or a change to network access takes effect after VU Studio restarts.

password.title: Password
password.removeHelp: Access from other devices will be switched off, and everyone signed in will be signed out.
password.localOnly: For safety, the password can only be changed on the PC where VU Studio runs.

token.title: API token
token.description: Lets scripts and other programs send values to VU Studio.
token.label: Token
token.regenerateHelp: Programs using the old token stop working once you save.
token.unsaved: New token: save your changes to start using it.
token.tooShort: Too short: generate a new token (at least 16 characters).
token.pushHelp: Send a value from any script. The token goes in the Authorization header.
token.pushIds: The example appears as the sensor push/demo/load in the Sensors list. Ids may use lowercase letters, digits and / _ . -

hosts.title: Allowed host names
hosts.description: Extra names that may be used to reach VU Studio.
hosts.label: Host names
hosts.help: Needed when you reach VU Studio through a custom DNS name or a reverse proxy, for example vustudio.home.lan. It protects against DNS rebinding attacks.

history.title: History
history.description: VU Studio keeps per-minute minimum, average and maximum values of the sensors your dials use, to draw charts.
history.enabledHelp: Turn it off to stop saving new data.
